verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an inference cloud, so the axis applies. The evidence only says to set api_key to 'your DeepInfra token' and never documents scoped, least-privilege, per-agent, or restricted keys. A generic API token does not count as scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
